senses.gloss:
स्थौणेय n. (-यं) A sort of perfume, commonly Ganthiala.
 E. स्थूणा an
image, &c., ढक् or ढकञ् aff.; also with कन् added, स्थौणेयक ।

स्थौर n. (-रं)
 1. Strength, power.
 2. A sufficient load for a horse or an
ass, &c.
 E. स्थूल large, bulky, अण् aff., and ल changed to र ।

स्थौरिन m. (-री)
 1. A pack-horse, one that carries burdens on his back
like an ox or ass.
 2. A strong horse.
 E. स्थौर strength, इनि aff.; or
according to some authorities स्थुरा a pack-saddle, इनि aff., deriv.
irr.; it is also read स्थूरिन्, स्थूरिन्, and स्थोरिन् ।

स्थौलशीर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) Large-headed, having or relating to a large
head or summit.
 E. स्थूल large, शिरस् the head, अण् aff.

स्थौल्य n. (-ल्यं) Bulkiness, bigness, coarseness, largeness.
 E. स्थूल, and ष्यञ् aff.
